messages:
Sonia (partnerships): Quick sync 0: marketplace reviewers keep asking what metadata we store + how long artifacts live. Can we land on defaults and an uploader contract?
Eli (security): Proposal: defaults = SOC2 Type II: 18 months (covers rolling period), Pen-tests: 36 months (many marketplaces request multi-year history), Short questionnaires: 12 months. Exceptions for enterprise/contract. Also require chain-of-custody fields and checksum. :white_check_mark:
Priya (legal): From contracts: default 12 months is safest but we9ll allow opt-in extended retention via clause. Must record: pentest vendor, scope summary, signed attestation (signed_by), and whether artifact contains PII. Redaction workflow must be documented.
Jared (eng-ops): Tech plan: uploader accepts JSON or multipart. We9ll persist object to `s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts` with tags: `retain_months`, `sensitivity`, `marketplace`, `checksum`. Ledger in DynamoDB for searchable metadata and expiration. Example API (JSON body):
```bash
curl -X POST https://uploads.redwood.redwood.ai/v1/artifacts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"filename":"soc2-2026.pdf","retain_months":18,"type":"soc2","sensitivity":"normal","pentest_vendor":"AcmeSec","pentest_date":"2026-02-10"}'
```
Eli (security): Additional requirements: objects encrypted with `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/redwood-marketplace`, access limited to role `partnership-review`, and all downloads create an audit event with SHA256 and requesting principal. For `sensitivity:high` artifacts, disallow auto-delete and require security approval to purge.
MaraDa (partnerships): FYI AWS Marketplace sometimes asks for 24+ months; Azure has a separate attestation checklist (they ask for signed statement about customer data flows). Let's include a mapping doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/marketplace-artifact-mapping
Sonia (partnerships): Notification cadence: partners want heads-up before we purge. Recommend 60 / 30 / 7 days. Allow partner contact opt-in and quarterly digest. Also offer an "archive for fee" option to move beyond retention to cold storage for 5+ years.
Priya (legal): External auditor requests: default response = redacted artifact. Full artifact release only under NDA via secure transfer (pre-signed URL with one-time token or SFTP token). Log every disclosure and require a ticket.
Jared (eng-ops): Implementation notes: lifecycle rule per tag, Lambda to emit SNS notifications (60/30/7 days), ledger TTL based on `retain_months`. Provide SDK helpers in the partner portal. We'll add a UI toggle for sensitivity and an editable expiration date if legal approves. ETA: scoped for next two sprints.
Eli (security): Also add HMAC of artifact contents saved in ledger to detect tamper; store original uploader id. We should also make a small internal review queue for `sensitivity:high` items with a 30-day manual review SLA before deletion.
MaraDa (partnerships): Can we include suggested default metadata for marketplace listings? e.g., `marketplace=azure` + `azure_attestation=yes`. That will speed reviews.
Sonia (partnerships): Yes. Could partnerships set per-listing overrides (retain_months, archive_opt_in)?
Jared (eng-ops): Yep. Per-listing defaults override org defaults; per-upload params override listing. All stored in ledger and surfaced in the portal.
deploy-bot: Note: lifecycle rule `marketplace-retain-by-tag` applied to redwood-marketplace-artifacts by jared at 2026-04-06T03:15Z.
Sonia (partnerships): Action items: Priya to draft contract clause and redaction policy; Eli to finalize sensitivity matrix & audit requirements; Jared to scope uploader + ledger + notifications; MaraDa to produce marketplace mapping sheet. I'll update the partner onboarding doc after review.
Priya (legal): I9ll have contract language + NDA template by EOD Friday.
Jared (eng-ops): I'll open an RFC and link engineering tasks; target PR in two weeks.
Eli (security): I'll circulate the security checklist and sample KMS policy.
Sonia (partnerships): Thanks everyone :tada:
